Manual: video coded by two researchers (alpha 0.80 on 20%), rest split

fields.v: Single study: 10 US developers, one codebase, GitHub Copilot with Claude Sonnet 4.6 in March 2026; tools have since evolved; eligibility largely self-reported. Screen recordings show interaction, not thinking (monitoring time may overstate attention). Understanding only on Tasks 1-2; process and solution scores summed. Participant-level, not temporal or causal; two personas rest on one participant; median splits not statistical categories; agent responses not coded. Future: larger samples, statistical tests, independent reliability data, timestamp linking, eye tracking
